interpretation.plain_speak: Before each mixed write, Wingless could tell perfectly whether that write would erase one of the original durable memories. It caught all 53 destructive writes and raised no false alarms.
interpretation.north_star_question: Upgrades exact slot forecasting into an explicit pre-loss warning signal tied to durable-memory preservation, still without taking any action.
interpretation.next_stage: test the same warning against several preregistered protected cohorts rather than the entire original set, asking whether Wingless can identify capability-specific loss risk without semantic priority
